prompt:

LEFT: ONE real adult Maori man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth warm olive-brown skin, a bright open smile showing his teeth, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a copper round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, an iron barrel-shaped weight, an iron square-sided cowbell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal rings.
